_provenance: Emergent repose angle from local toppling rules. The pile's slope is never named in the genome — it either emerges from the physics or it does not. Design Laws 1+3 as physics: simple agents producing complex order.

walls.unsettled_worst: The pile MUST reach a fixed point. A config that never settles is not a sandpile — it is a fluid with no repose, and the domain has no floor.
walls.angle_mean_deg: The emergent angle MUST fall inside the researched granular range (26-42 deg). Below 18 deg is a puddle, not a pile; above 42 deg violates the Coulomb friction ceiling for loose regolith. This is the domain's headline: a physics fact the genome never names.
walls.angle_consistency_deg: Flank angle and aspect angle MUST converge. A pile where the fitted slope disagrees with the peak geometry by >10 deg is a needle-on-apron — a frozen chimney atop a free-grain apron — not a coherent emergent form.
walls.frozen_fraction_mean: Cohesion MUST stay modest. A frozen fraction above 0.25 means the pile is a glued sculpture, not a self-organizing granular system — the 'autonomous function' property dissolves.
walls.probe_locality_worst: A single-grain perturbation MUST remain local. This IS the emergence thesis measured: cost proportional to CHANGE, not to world size. Zero locality means every poke triggers a system-spanning avalanche — no computation has halted.
